title: Derive replayable authority deadlines and persistent timer modifiers
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export deadline derivation/checking helpers accepting injected trusted integer time, configured30/60/90/120-second duration and typed modifiers. Model I01 next-round−10seconds and S5 persistent−15seconds with Blackout minimum30seconds. D-TIMER-COMPOSITION must settle the exact order/floor when modifiers overlap or I01 affects a30-second round; do not invent the missing edge policy. Never call Date, timers or clock APIs in engine. Distinguish rendering a countdown from authorizing a deadline transition and reject client-controlled deadline/force data.
acceptance: Every supported base duration and approved modifier combination has exact deterministic duration/deadline boundary fixtures.
Actions before/at/after a deadline are decided from injected trusted time with safe integer validation and replayable results.
The persistent Blackout reduction cannot reset on a later round/reconnect and one-round I01 modifiers cannot persist indefinitely.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
